package.title: Promotions and Incentives: The Case of Multistage Elimination Tournaments
package.authors: Steffen Altmann, Armin Falk, Matthias Wibral
package.publisher: University of Chicago Press / Society of Labor Economists
package.paper_type: Controlled laboratory experiment (tournament theory); OLS/regression + nonparametric tests on z-Tree data

mode: static audit + closed-form recompute (equilibrium predictions, one-sample t, z->p); independent raw-data reimplementation NOT possible - no data/code obtainable

inputs.paper_extracted.txt: full text (1202 lines), scanned-JSTOR OCR extraction
inputs.data_and_code: NONE. No data deposit, no code, no ICPSR/Dataverse/OSF/GitHub link found in text or via web search (DDG 2026-09-14).

01_internal_consistency.R: recompute Nash equilibrium e* from wages (c=2250,q=60): all treatments -> 73.97 ~ 74
one-sample t of Table-2 means vs e*=74 from reported mean/SD/N (C18-C24)

reproducible.equilibrium_predictions: ALL 4 treatments reproduce e*=74 exactly to rounding
reproducible.one_sample_t_vs_equilibrium: 6/7 within 0.005 of reported p (1 more, OS, within 0.009)

not_independent: treatment means/medians/min/max/SD (Table 2) require raw z-Tree data
Mann-Whitney U / Wilcoxon tests require raw data
